title: Subnet News — August 10, 2026
summary: Hippius launched Drive, Score patched a latency-loop exploit, OpenRoboto completed a benchmark upgrade, Beam fixed suppressed task allocation, Verathos shipped v0.1.32, and Poker44 opened miner training tournaments. Developing stories include RedTeam enterprise-scale claims amid scoring failures, a BASE harness exploit awaiting causality checks, Quasar ownership-transition signals, and early Cascade, InfiniteQuant, Targon, and Conjectures milestones. Sixteen subnets produced material reportable signals; the other 112 had no public update strong enough for inclusion.

highlights.summary: Hippius launched client-side encrypted distributed file storage with user-held recovery credentials and no retrieval egress fees; broad hyperscaler comparisons remain workload-dependent.

gaps: X indexing was incomplete and some official posts exposed no readable body without login; directly resolved post URLs were retained where corroborating coverage captured the announcement.
Many primary Discord messages require Bittensor server membership or login; SubnetRadar briefs that link the exact original message IDs were used when direct reading was unavailable.
Public GitHub search did not reliably surface every subnet repository or release tag, so Discord-announced releases without an attributable public tag were verified only as team deployments.
Quasar ownership, InfiniteQuant performance, Cascade progress, RedTeam enterprise scale, Conjectures problem solves and future Targon hardware dates remain team-reported and are labeled developing.

Registry names are moving quickly after slot handovers and rebrands; SN39 was updated to Cathedral from the prior report, while unconfirmed or conflicting slot-name changes were not silently rewritten.
No item in this report is financial advice. Price, flow, emission, burn and conviction observations describe public data and do not predict future performance.
